scope: Transformer manufacturing, components, testing and service, and utility procurement in Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. Use the issuing buyer’s documents and addenda to confirm eligibility and deadlines. These profiles illustrate the supply chain, not a list of approved bidders.

portals.name: DEWA open tenders
portals.description: Dubai’s live listing shows notices and amendments. Full documents may carry a fee; online bids generally use DEWA’s registered vendor system. A tender-opening result does not establish an award.

portals.name: TAQA supplier registration guide
portals.description: Official registration path for TAQA, including TAQA Transmission and TAQA Distribution. Registration does not guarantee an invitation.

portals.name: Saudi Energy supplier and e-bidding portal
portals.description: Saudi Electricity Company’s utility materials procurement route. Check the invitation, the registered material class and any manufacturer qualification before relying on a listing.

portals.name: Etimad government tenders
portals.description: Arabic-first public government tender search. Filter by government entity, reference and status; document access or bidding can require a supplier account.

portals.name: ESNAD government tenders
portals.description: Oman’s public dashboard distinguishes floated, opened, awarded and cancelled procurement. The official notice determines whether a purchase is local, international or reserved for SMEs.

portals.name: Nama Group supplier registration guide
portals.description: Separate utility entry points for Oman Electricity Transmission Company and Nama Electricity Distribution, among other group companies. Use the buyer named in the notice.

portals.name: Central Agency for Public Tenders (CAPT)
portals.description: Start here for public notices and addenda for Ministry of Electricity, Water and Renewable Energy contracts. Some documents or archive access may require a registered company; the ministry publishes technical specifications separately.

portals.name: KAHRAMAA tenders
portals.description: Search the utility’s notices and use its separate Awards tab. Check the actual submission date and latest amendment, even when an older notice still displays Open.

portals.name: Monaqasat state procurement
portals.description: Qatar’s Ministry of Finance procurement portal. Check supplier classification and follow the specific notice for document purchase, bid submission and bond requirements.

portals.name: Bahrain government tender services
portals.description: Official entry to Tender Board notices, separate opening results and awards, and supplier registration. Check any local/GCC or prequalification restriction in the notice.

portals.name: EWA procurement notices
portals.description: Electricity and Water Authority procurement page. Follow the channel and submission conditions named in each notice; some opportunities use the Tender Board.

companies.name: Federal Power Transformers
companies.description: Abu Dhabi power-transformer manufacturing at ICAD 1. The group distinguishes this business from its distribution-transformer company.

companies.name: Nuhas Emirates National Copper Factory
companies.description: Abu Dhabi conductor supplier whose catalogue includes paper-insulated copper conductors and enamelled copper wire. Confirm the current dimensions and insulation system for the winding design.

companies.name: Saudi Power Transformers (SPTC)
companies.description: Electrical Industries Co. identifies SPTC as its Dammam power transformer manufacturing subsidiary. Confirm the rating and current plant qualification for the specific order.

companies.name: alfanar
companies.description: Manufacturer catalogue includes dry-type and oil-immersed transformers, medium power transformers and package substations.

companies.name: United Transformers Electric (UTEC)
companies.description: Bawan identifies UTEC as its electrical transformer manufacturer in Saudi Arabia. Consult the product catalogue for the offered configuration and the specific plant.

companies.name: Voltamp Energy
companies.description: The company describes its distribution and medium-power business at Rusayl and a distinct Sohar power-transformer facility. The proposed Sohar Freezone site is a separate development.

companies.name: Al Jizzi Transformers & Switchgears
companies.description: Company lists pole-mounted and special transformer production, as well as packaged substations, at its Muscat-area facilities.

companies.name: Al-Ahleia Switchgear
companies.description: Kuwaiti company’s catalogue lists oil-filled power and distribution transformers. Verify the quoted unit and current approvals directly with the buyer.

news.title: Bahrain opens bids for 1,000 kVA oil-filled transformers
news.summary: Bahrain Tender Board recorded five bids at opening for EWA Central Stores reference PT/CSD/HR/2026/129. Bid opening is not a contract award.

news.title: Siemens Energy cites a large power transformer factory at Dammam
news.summary: Siemens Energy’s CEO describes a large power-transformer factory as part of its Dammam expansion, intended to serve Saudi buyers and exports. The company’s update does not state a commissioning date or available production capacity.

news.title: Voltamp discloses a new company and Sohar land lease
news.summary: Voltamp Energy’s Muscat Stock Exchange disclosure records incorporation of Voltamp International and signing of a land lease for a planned export-oriented power-transformer facility. This is separate from its existing Sohar operation and is not a commissioning notice.

news.title: DEWA reports new transformation capacity in Dubai
news.summary: DEWA reported commissioning 1,200 MVA across eight 132 kV substations and 2,000 MVA at the Saih Al Dahal 400/132 kV substation in the first half of 2026. The figures are substation transformation capacity, not awards or individual transformer ratings.

news.title: KAHRAMAA solicited investigation and repair of 315 MVA transformers
news.summary: The published deadline for GTC/1295/2025 was 25 June 2026. The scope specified work on 220/132 kV, 315 MVA shell-type transformers at Ras Laffan, with Doha South Super optional. The notice does not establish an award.

news.title: SPTC signs Saudi HV/EHV transformer and reactor localization contract
news.summary: Electrical Industries Co. disclosed a signed SAR 1.411 billion contract excluding VAT, covering both transformers and reactors over 84 months. The figure is the disclosed initial contract value, not a transformer-only amount.

context.title: Saudi 60 Hz and the 50 Hz regional interconnector
context.summary: GCCIA reports a 400 kV, 50 Hz interconnector linked to Saudi Arabia’s 60 Hz system through a back-to-back HVDC station. Confirm frequency on the buyer’s specification and transformer nameplate rather than assuming it from the region.

context.title: Saudi utility prequalification is product- and factory-specific
context.summary: National Grid SA distinguishes an already qualified factory, a new plant and a licensed product made at a different plant. Verify the latest specification and the approval for the maker, plant and offered design.

context.title: Oman distribution products have individual approval scopes
context.summary: The Distribution Code Review Panel lists manufacturers by product type and rating, with approval and expiry dates. A listed company does not automatically qualify for every rating or project.

context.title: Kuwait buyer specifications
context.summary: The Ministry of Electricity, Water and Renewable Energy lists transformer specifications under its technical references. Use the current procurement specification and addenda for an offer.

context.title: GCCIA direct Oman connection remains a project
context.summary: GCCIA describes a planned direct link involving new 400 kV substations at Ibri and Baynonah. This is infrastructure context, not an open transformer tender or unit order.
